review.verdicts: A QUALIFIED, B PASS, C QUALIFIED, D QUALIFIED (weak), E QUALIFIED; recommendation HOLD

reason: The 6-vertex S1S2 counterexample to Kobeaga-Merino-Lozano Conjecture 6.2 is correct under the printed rules, but it depends solely on the global witness clause of rule S1 (Theorem 4.4), which the authors' reference implementation (gkobeaga/cpsrksec, and later op-solver) does not test; under the implemented semantics and under the authors' fixed-depot setting the reviewer found no failure (all half-integral inputs to n = 7 and 116,381 random points), and the authors' later work drops S2. Root judges it a printed-definition versus implementation artefact of weak significance under the substantive credit standard. Kobeaga's 2021 thesis (BCAM open copy, read by the reviewer) restates it as Conjecture 3.22, still open; no resolution found.
